summary: All request-bound DTOs carry @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true). The trigger-array DoS surface (Decision 14) is closed at the contract boundary: @Size(max=50) on UpdateFunnelRequest.triggers + @Valid cascade enforces the per-trigger keyword cap in TriggerDto. Response DTOs (FunnelResponse, FunnelSummaryResponse) expose no over-permissive or server-internal fields. No injection surface, no secrets or PII in DTO fields. One low-severity observation (no per-keyword length cap annotation on TriggerDto.keywords) is correctly delegated to FunnelService per the design — not a gap. No findings require a code change before Task 4.

owasp_coverage.A03_injection: PASS — no raw query construction in DTOs; triggerType/triggerValue/keywords are plain strings passed to FunnelService which owns slug-regex validation (TRIGGER_VALUE_PATTERN, EVENT_NAME_PATTERN). No injection surface introduced.
owasp_coverage.A04_insecure_design_dos: PASS — @Size(max=50) on UpdateFunnelRequest.triggers closes the array-bloat DoS surface (Decision 14). @Valid cascade into TriggerDto enforces @Size(max=50) on keywords per trigger element, bounding the N×keyword scan cost. Service-side re-checks (MAX_KEYWORDS, MAX_KEYWORD_LENGTH) remain in FunnelService untouched.
owasp_coverage.A05_security_misconfiguration: PASS — @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true) present on both request-bound DTOs (UpdateFunnelRequest, TriggerDto). FunnelResponse and FunnelSummaryResponse are response-only (server-authored, never deserialized from untrusted input); omission of @JsonIgnoreProperties there is correct.
owasp_coverage.A06_vulnerable_components: N/A — no new dependencies introduced (user-spec constraint upheld).
owasp_coverage.A07_auth_failures: PASS — DTOs carry no auth-bypass surface; projectId/funnelId are path variables enforced by FunnelController.currentUserId() + FunnelService.requireFunnel() anti-IDOR discipline, unchanged by this task.
owasp_coverage.A08_software_integrity: PASS — no deserialization of polymorphic types; flat records with no _class discriminator, matching the FunnelStepDto precedent.
owasp_coverage.A09_logging: PASS — DTO fields (triggerType, triggerValue, keywords, entryStepId) carry no PII. No logging introduced in this task. Service-level WARN markers (Task 5) are the logging boundary — not touched here.

findings.title: Per-keyword string length cap not annotated on TriggerDto.keywords
findings.description: TriggerDto.keywords carries @Size(max=50) bounding the count, but has no @Size(max=64) annotation on individual keyword strings. An attacker can submit keywords of arbitrary length within the 50-element ceiling. The per-keyword length cap (MAX_KEYWORD_LENGTH=64) is enforced in FunnelService.applyTrigger and is explicitly deferred to Task 4 per the task spec and tech-spec Decision 14 commentary. This is an expected gap at this wave boundary — flagged for completeness only.
findings.impact: A request body with 50 keywords each of e.g. 10 000 characters (~500 KB) passes DTO validation and reaches FunnelService. FunnelService rejects it with 422, so no persistence or keyword-scan amplification occurs. Overhead is bounded by Spring's request-size limit (existing infrastructure). No data integrity or security breach.
findings.recommendation: Task 4 must preserve FunnelService.MAX_KEYWORD_LENGTH (64) enforcement on each keyword string within applyTrigger, which is already spec'd. Optionally, add @Size(max=64) on each List<String> element via a custom constraint or a @Valid cascade with a wrapper — but this is purely defense-in-depth and lower priority than the service check.

mass_assignment_defense.UpdateFunnelRequest: PRESENT — @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true) at class level; hostile fields (e.g. status, projectId, id) are silently dropped. Confirmed by TriggerDtoTest::deserializeIgnoresUnknownProperties.
mass_assignment_defense.TriggerDto: PRESENT — @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true) at class level; unknown fields within a trigger element are dropped (test covers bogus:1 inside the array element).
mass_assignment_defense.FunnelResponse: N/A — response DTO, not deserialized from untrusted input. No @JsonIgnoreProperties needed.
mass_assignment_defense.FunnelSummaryResponse: N/A — response DTO, not deserialized from untrusted input. No @JsonIgnoreProperties needed.

dos_bounding_decision14.per_keyword_length_cap: Service-side only (FunnelService.MAX_KEYWORD_LENGTH=64, Task 4 scope) — NOT annotated on DTO, expected gap
dos_bounding_decision14.array_cap_value_alignment: MAX_TRIGGERS=50 aligned with max-fanout-per-event/max-steps order of magnitude per Decision 14 — CORRECT

response_field_exposure.FunnelResponse: Exposes: id, projectId, name, description, status, allowReEnter, triggers (array), steps, deepLink, createdAt, updatedAt. No internal server fields (e.g. onStartTriggerValue, internal CAS fields) exposed. deepLink is correctly documented as derived from on_start triggerValue by FunnelService mapper (Task 4).
response_field_exposure.FunnelSummaryResponse: Exposes: id, projectId, name, description, status, allowReEnter, triggers (array), stepCount, createdAt, updatedAt. No over-permissive fields.
response_field_exposure.verdict: PASS — no onStartTriggerValue or other server-internal denormalized field leaks into the response contract.

injection_surface.triggerType: String, passed to FunnelService.normalizeTriggerType which validates against VALID_TRIGGER_TYPES allowlist — SAFE
injection_surface.triggerValue: String, passed to FunnelService slug-regex validators (TRIGGER_VALUE_PATTERN, EVENT_NAME_PATTERN) — SAFE
injection_surface.keywords: List<String>, normalized in FunnelService (lowercase, trim, de-dupe, length cap) — SAFE
injection_surface.entryStepId: String, resolved against stepsSnapshot in Task 4/5 — SAFE at DTO boundary

pii_secrets_audit.verdict: PASS — no PII, API keys, secrets, or credential fields in any DTO. triggerValue/eventName are user-defined slugs with slug-regex constraints applied at service layer.

test_coverage_security_relevant.TriggerDtoTest::deserializeIgnoresUnknow: Covers mass-assignment defense at both UpdateFunnelRequest and TriggerDto level — ADEQUATE
test_coverage_security_relevant.TriggerDtoTest::validCascadesIntoTrigger: Proves @Valid cascade reaches per-trigger keyword cap — ADEQUATE
test_coverage_security_relevant.missing: No test for a keyword string exceeding 64 chars being rejected (delegated to Task 4 service-level test, per spec). Acceptable at this boundary.

known_non_findings: Module does not compile (FunnelService.update() still references removed flat fields triggerType/triggerValue/keywords from UpdateFunnelRequest) — expected, noted in brief as Task 4 scope.
FunnelService trigger validation (entryStepId resolution, slug regex, duplicate event_name) not present — expected, Task 4 scope.
onStartTriggerValue sync absent from DTOs — correct: it is a server-internal field, must NOT appear in request or response DTOs.
Per-keyword length @Size annotation absent — correctly deferred to service layer per Decision 14 commentary.
